# Sai Kanagat

> Sai Prathyaksh Kanagat is an industrial designer and digital marketer based in Bologna, Italy. His work spans brand strategy, paid media, marketing technology, product design and applied AI.

## Key pages
- [About](https://saikanagat.com/about): background, education and experience
- [Work](https://saikanagat.com/work): selected design, marketing and AI projects
- [Blog](https://saikanagat.com/blog): writing on design, marketing and building
- [Demos](https://saikanagat.com/demos): interactive browser experiments
- [Contact](https://saikanagat.com/contact): how to get in touch

## Selected projects
- [Cortex Studio](https://saikanagat.com/cortex): multi-agent AI creative studio
- [Aperol, The Golden Hour](https://saikanagat.com/aperol-golden-hour): speculative India launch campaign
- [Content Vigilante](https://saikanagat.com/work#vigilante): local-first, open-source marketing OS
- [Monocular Biomechanics](https://saikanagat.com/papers/monocular-biomechanics): research paper
